compatibleWeaponFamily is a local magazine AttachDef tag, not a localized display family; compatibleWeaponClass is parsed from that local tag

damageDropPerMeter is stored as a decimal value, not converted to a displayed percentage
bullet impulse falloff is separate from damage falloff and is not used to calculate damage drop

quality modifier properties are indexed as tokens only, not final stats
